script_text: The stars are pulling back the curtain — and what Mercury reveals now will shake everything you've been avoiding. Mercury turns backward through Virgo, the Earth sign it rules, reversing communication, travel, and decision-making energy. The cosmos is forcing you to confront unfinished business head-on. This retrograde ignites your 7th House of Partnerships, triggering raw confrontations in relationships, while a hard square from Saturn to your 10th House of Career demands serious accountability at work. Expect miscommunications with loved ones and sudden professional delays that force real rebuilding. The retrograde conjunct the North Node exposes deep karmic debts through Chiron's ancient wound, revealing heartbreak that still controls your decisions. The universe isn't punishing you — it's cosmic recalibration. Harness Virgo's grounded Earth energy — journal every morning and never sign contracts during this cycle. Comment your sign below and tell Mercury what you're finally ready to release.
